page: Microsoft Azure M128bds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor with 128 vCPUs (64 physical cores, 2 threads per core) operating at 4.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 2794.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 21.83 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 6144 GB SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results highlight top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 9024.88 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 187.69 GB/sec. The server demonstrates exceptional database and transactional capabilities, achieving 139.35 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and scoring in the top 10% for PassMark database operations. Multi-threaded processing is highly efficient, as evidenced by a top-tier bzip3 multi-threaded decompression speed of 663.27 GB/sec and a strong multi-core Geekbench score of 20402.0.

The underlying Intel Xeon architecture includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) for deep learning and mathematical operations. This hardware profile makes the instance highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy enterprise database operations, and memory-intensive data processing. While single-core performance falls within the average range, the massive parallel processing capacity and high memory density deliver excellent qualitative cost efficiency for consolidated enterprise workloads.
